trigger: User uploaded video showing Level 30B / 29 / 28 appearing too early and level cards apparently nested under the wrong section.

diagnosis.problem: Fix 004 made Level 3+ visible but allowed real legacy level nodes to mix with placeholder cards. Some legacy level nodes appeared in the wrong order or nested under the wrong parent.
observed_glitches: Level 30B appeared too early after Level 4.
Level 29 and Level 28 appeared before Levels 5-27.
Some cards looked nested under the wrong level section.
Ordering was not canonical even though visibility was restored.

what_changed: Level 3+ now uses canonical shell cards for each ordered level from 3 through 30B.
Real legacy level nodes are moved into the matching canonical shell instead of being allowed to define order by their original DOM position.
Heading-text detection was added for legacy cards that do not expose the expected data selector.
Nested legacy cards are de-nested into their matching canonical level shell where possible.
Loose or duplicate level-like nodes outside the canonical stack are contained as duplicates only, not because they are unready.
